milestones.title: Sprint 1 - Ingestion
milestones.description: Goal: Florida Medicare Part D prescribing (2022-2024) and national drug spending land in Snowflake as raw JSON, by tested Bash automation that resumes and verifies.

milestones.title: Sprint 2 - dbt models
milestones.description: Goal: staging, intermediate and mart models with tests and documentation run green on Snowflake semantics (fakesnow locally, a trial account when available).

milestones.title: Sprint 3 - BI
milestones.description: Goal: a Power BI project (TMDL + PBIR) and Tableau Hyper extracts built from the marts, with the questions they answer written down.

milestones.title: Sprint 4 - Release
milestones.description: Goal: Terraform for Snowflake, CI green, measured run times, README and data dictionary.

milestones.title: Backlog
milestones.description: Not scheduled: work that needs an account or a later sprint.

issues.title: Repository scaffold, CI skeleton and dev environment
issues.body:
As a contributor, I want one command for setup and CI that lints and tests every push.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] uv, dbt, shellcheck and bats run in CI
- [ ] secret scan before every push and in CI

issues.title: Extract CMS Part D data with resumable, paged Bash
issues.body:
As a data engineer, I want a Bash extractor that pages through the CMS data API with retries, rate limiting and resume, so that a dropped connection never means starting over.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `set -euo pipefail`, shellcheck clean, bats tests against a local fake API
- [ ] row counts verified against the API's own count

issues.title: Load raw JSON into Snowflake (stage, COPY INTO, VARIANT)
issues.body:
As an analytics engineer, I want the raw pages in a VARIANT column with load metadata, so that dbt models can be rebuilt from the raw layer at any time.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] idempotent loads (re-running a year replaces it)
- [ ] works against fakesnow locally and a real account by configuration only

issues.title: Spike: can dbt-snowflake run against a local Snowflake emulator?
issues.body: Decide how CI tests Snowflake SQL without an account. Outcome recorded as an ADR.

issues.title: Staging models: typed and deduplicated
issues.body: As an analyst, I want typed, renamed staging models over the raw VARIANT data, with tests for keys, nulls and accepted values.

issues.title: Marts: prescribing, drug spend, generic opportunity, opioid and GLP-1 trends
issues.body:
As a pharmacy director, I want marts that answer where spend grows, which brand drugs have cheaper generics, how opioid and GLP-1 prescribing move by specialty and county, so that decisions start from one source of truth.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] every mart has a grain, tests and a description
- [ ] CMS small-cell suppression respected

issues.title: Data quality: dbt tests and source freshness
issues.body: As a data owner, I want tests that fail the run on broken keys or impossible values, and a reconciliation of totals against CMS's published numbers.

issues.title: Power BI project (TMDL semantic model + PBIR report)
issues.body:
As a pharmacy analyst, I want a Power BI report over the marts, kept as text in git, so that changes are reviewed like code.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] opens in Power BI Desktop and refreshes from the exported marts
- [ ] report JSON validated against Microsoft's schemas in CI

issues.title: Tableau Hyper extracts from the marts
issues.body:
As a Tableau user, I want the marts as .hyper extracts built by the pipeline, so that a workbook can be refreshed without a database connection.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] extracts read back and reconciled with the marts in a test

issues.title: Terraform for Snowflake (warehouse, database, roles, resource monitor)
issues.body:
As a platform engineer, I want the Snowflake objects and a credit cap as code, so that the trial account cannot overspend.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] validate, tflint and trivy pass; nothing applied without an account

issues.title: Measured run times and README
issues.body: As a hiring manager, I want the problem, design, results and limits on one page, with every number from a committed file.

issues.title: Run on a Snowflake trial account
issues.body: Blocked on the owner creating a Snowflake trial (30 days, $400 of credit, no card). Steps in docs/DEPLOY.md.

issues.title: Publish the Tableau dashboard on Tableau Public
issues.body: Blocked on a Tableau Public account. The extracts and the dashboard specification are in bi/tableau/.

issues.title: GitHub Projects board for the sprints
issues.body: The CLI token lacks the `project` scope. After `gh auth refresh -s project`, run `python scripts/agile/sync_backlog.py --board`.

issues.title: Bug: name patterns put apomorphine in opioids, insulin syringes in insulin and Contrave in OUD treatment
issues.body:
Found by listing every generic name each class pattern matched on the full 2022-2024 data.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] classes are assigned per product (brand x generic), so Butrans and Belbuca (pain) and Sublocade (OUD) are told apart
- [ ] exceptions are ordered rules in the seed, each with a reason
- [ ] a dbt test pins every reviewed edge case
- [ ] the opioid definitions follow CDC's (cough products and OUD buprenorphine are not analgesics)

issues.title: Bash orchestration of the whole batch with a run report
issues.body:
As an operator, I want one command that extracts, loads, builds, exports and publishes metrics, and that writes what happened even when a stage fails.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] per-stage timings and the failing stage in reports/pipeline-run.json
- [ ] bats tests for success, failure and extraction
- [ ] the same script runs locally, in Docker and in CI on the committed sample

issues.title: Observability: run metrics, alert rules with tests, Grafana dashboard
issues.body:
As an on-call engineer, I want to know when a run failed, went stale, failed data tests or produced an extract that does not match the marts.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] metrics pushed to a Pushgateway after every run
- [ ] alert rules with promtool tests and a runbook entry each
- [ ] a provisioned Grafana dashboard

issues.title: Docker images and a one-command local stack
issues.body:
**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `make up` starts the emulator and the monitoring with health checks
- [ ] the pipeline image runs the batch against it; CI runs this end to end and checks Prometheus
